transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Thank you so much for seeing me, I really appreciate it. Um, well, I guess I'm here because... I've just been having a little bit of trouble at work lately. Nothing huge, just, you know, some silly mistakes on my sales reports. Like, I'll accidentally copy the wrong numbers from the team dashboard, or maybe miss a step in a procedure I'm supposed to review. It's so frustrating because I really do try to double-check everything, and I always think I've got it right, but then... yeah. I hope that makes sense? I just want to make sure I'm doing a good job for my team, you know?
Have you had trouble paying attention since you were a child?

Um, well... yeah, I suppose I was a little bit like this back then, too. I mean, I wasn't a bad kid or anything! Just, you know, maybe a bit energetic. My mom actually still jokes about the little notes my teachers used to send home in elementary school. They’d say things like I rushed through my work a bit too fast, or, um, I’d accidentally lose my homework. And I guess I had a habit of talking out of turn or needing a reminder to just stay in my seat. But I really always meant well, I promise. I just got a little eager, I think. Does that make sense? I hope that's the kind of information you're looking for.
Do you notice the same kind of careless mistakes or trouble focusing outside of work, like at home?

Um... yeah, I guess I do sometimes. Not all the time, of course! But, you know, just regular life stuff slips my mind every now and then. Like... well, I might forget to return a call to my attorney right away, or, um, I might not realize a bill is due until I get one of those little reminder notices. And sometimes I'll promise the kids I'll pick something up on the way home and just completely blank on it. I always feel terrible about it, because I really do try to stay on top of things for them. I just get a little scattered sometimes, I think. Is that... is that normal for people to do sometimes?
Have these attention and careless-mistake problems been present pretty consistently throughout your adult life?

Um, well... I wouldn't say it's been *this* noticeable my whole adult life. I mean, I've always been a little bit, you know, on the go, but I usually managed okay. It's really just been... well, since I got promoted to supervisor, actually. That was about a year and two months ago. It's a great opportunity, and I'm so grateful for it! But there's just a lot more paperwork and tracking involved now, and I guess that's when these little slip-ups really started becoming a... a real problem for me. I just want to be a good leader for the team, you know? Do you think the new role just brought it out more?
Do you find yourself worrying a lot more than other people seem to?

Um, no, not really. I mean, I wouldn't say I'm a worrier, exactly! I mean, sure, I want to do a good job at work and I care about my kids, so I think about those things, but... it's not like I'm sitting around anxious all the time or anything like that. I think I handle stress pretty well, for the most part. Just normal, everyday stuff, you know? I hope that doesn't make me sound like I don't care, because I definitely do! I just try to keep a positive attitude about things. Is that... is that the right way to handle it?
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Oh, no, I wouldn't say that at all. I mean, everybody has their off days, right? But I'm generally a pretty upbeat guy! I try to focus on the good things—like the promotion, and the kids, and just trying to do my best for everyone. I don't really get, you know, down in the dumps or anything. I just want to make sure I'm doing a good job and being a good dad. I hope that's what you're looking for... I mean, it's okay to just be a little scattered without being depressed, right?
